# Vendored Libraries

- cJSON 1.7.19, https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.19,
  MIT license in LICENSE. Compiled with a nesting limit of 32.
- Monocypher 4.0.3, https://monocypher.org/download/, including optional
  Ed25519/SHA-512. Dual BSD-2-Clause/CC0 license retained in each source file.

These sources are unmodified. They provide structured JSON parsing and release
signature verification; neither needs a shared library on the hub.
